artworks.title: The Beast with Two Horns LIke a Lamb
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an apocalyptic vision. The image features intricate and detailed line work depicting a scene with celestial and monstrous elements. In the upper section, there is a figure seated on clouds, adorned with a crown and surrounded by rays, accompanied by ethereal winged beings. Alongside them, a figure seems suspended at the edge of the frame. Below, ominous clouds release rain and a multi-headed beast with seven crowned heads and a lion-like body occupies the lower space, while various figures in robes gather. The line work creates contrasts and a sense of depth within the fantastical scene.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Lamb
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central lamb surrounded by various figures and symbolic imagery. The lamb stands within a radiant circle in the sky, holding a flag, and is surrounded by beams of light. The figures below are holding palm leaves, and the scene includes other animals, winged creatures, and elements suggestive of a celestial gathering. The drawing is detailed and intricate, with fine line work emphasizing the costumes and expressions of each figure.

artworks.title: The Whore of Babylon
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
artworks.description: Created with black lines printed on cream-white paper, a dense crowd of men and women gathers to our left facing a woman riding a dragon-like creature with seven heads to our right, while angels fly overhead in this vertical woodcut. To our right, the woman rides the creature side-saddle, with both legs facing us, but she turns her torso to face the crowd to our left. She holds up a tall, ornate, lidded chalice with her right hand, farther from us, and her other hand rests in her lap. The woman has delicate features, seen almost in profile, and ringlets frame her face. The rest of her hair is pulled up under a jeweled crown, and she wears a pearl necklace. Her bodice is belted at the waist before falling past her feet. Her sleeves are off the shoulder and come to her elbows, and ornaments there could be jewels and more pearls. The creature she rides has talons for the front and back legs, with a plume of feathers and a tapering, snake-like tail at the back. Wings at the beast’s shoulders might be folded under the woman. Each of the seven faces of the creature has a long, serpentine neck with the head of a different animal with horns added, including a goat, bird, camel, and other imaginary animals. To our left, the group is made up of six men and one woman, with the tops of about a dozen hats indicating a crowd beyond. One man stands with his back to us, wearing a turban, a long, fur-lined cloak, and chains and jewels around his neck. Facing us, another man is cleanshaven with a double chin, and he wears a hat cocked to one side. Others wear a long floppy cap, a feathered cap, or monk’s robes. Densely packed slivers of faces and hats are jumbled together beyond, and the spiked blade of a halberd rises above the crowd. The group and creature seem to stand near the edge of a body of water, with plants and rocks scattered around their feet. The water stretches into the distance beyond the creature to a town being consumed by flames, to our right. Two masted ships and a rowboat float in the water near the shoreline, which leads back to distant mountains. Two winged angels with flowing, curly hair appear within coiling, twisting clouds in the sky above. One gestures toward the scene below with arms spread wide and the other holds a disk-like millstone. Also in the sky, to our left and smaller in scale, an armored man riding a horse raises a sword high overhead. Dozens of faces create a second crowd disappearing into the cloud banks beyond the rider. The artist signed the work with a D tucked into the legs of an A at the lower center.

artworks.title: The Angel with the Key to the Bottomless Pit
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene featuring angels, a demon-like creature, and an elaborate city in the background. Two winged figures are working together to subdue a dragon-like beast. The angels are wearing long robes, with one holding keys. The creature has scaled legs and a fierce expression. The background shows a detailed cityscape with towers and walls among mountains. A barren tree and small houses complete the scene.

artworks.title: Gulliver Awed by Three Giant Beggars in the Land of Brobdingnag
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a surreal scene featuring a figure looking out of a window at three large faces. The painting depicts an interior setting with a figure seated on the floor facing away, looking out through a large window. Outside the window, three gigantic heads are visible, each with exaggerated features and expressions. The colors used are soft, with a mix of pinks, blues, and browns. The style of the painting closely resembles Gustave Doré's work. The surrounding curtains and furnishings are detailed, adding depth and perspective to the scene.

artworks.title: A Waterfall
artworks.medium: graphite with blue and gray wash, laid down on old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dian Woodner

artworks.title: The Catiline Conspiracy
artworks.medium: etching with engraving, drypoint, and punchwork
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in a classical setting. The figures are seated and standing, with detailed facial features and various hairstyles. They wear draped garments resembling togas or tunics and some wear sandals. There is a prominent chair, a small table, and a man holding a scroll. The background is a plain dark surface with a border featuring classical motifs. A sculptured male figure stands on a pedestal in the left background.

artworks.title: A New Year's Greeting
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring whimsical illustrations and decorative text. Intricate elements include ornate lettering and playful figures scattered across the page. In the upper left corner, there's a person in a decorative frame wearing a top hat. Below, there are figures of musicians playing drums and a small person with a dog on a leash. The text flows with embellishments and curls, displaying a decorative script. Various curly lines and motifs fill the spaces between the text and figures, adding artistic complexity to the piece.

artworks.title: On flaire la marchandise... avant de la mécaniser!...
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David E. Rust
artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted in a black and white illustration. The person on the left appears focused, leaning forward with tousled hair and pronounced facial features. They wear a loose shirt with rolled-up sleeves. The individual on the right, partially obscured by a cloth, has a furrowed expression. They are surrounded by food items on a table, including a pie and a wheel of cheese. The background shows hanging goods, suggesting a market or shop setting.

artworks.title: Un Jour de Grande Tenue
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David E. Rust
artworks.description: The image features two full-bodied figures standing side by side. The figure on the right is in a frontal position, facing forward and with one hand raised in a salute. This person has a large nose, pronounced facial features, and is wearing a tall, decorated military hat with a plume and a patterned emblem. Their hair is short and appears unkempt, sticking out from under the hat. The clothing is a detailed military uniform with buttons and a prominent collar. The figure on the left is shown in profile, facing left, and has a slim build with a defined mustache and a similar tall hat. This person's clothing is also a military uniform, with a belt crossing the chest. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Madame Prudhomme...
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David E. Rust
artworks.description: Three exaggerated figures in old-fashioned bathing suits walk on a beach. The figures have comically exaggerated body shapes and features. The drawing uses strong lines to highlight their proportions and expressions. In the background, two smaller figures are vaguely seen in the beach or water. The scene suggests a beach setting with a light-hearted and satirical mood.

artworks.title: Visitant l'interieur...
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David E. Rust
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anthropomorphic animals observing two figures. The drawing portrays a scene where two figures, possibly a person in uniform and an anthropomorphized figure, are standing among a group of apes or monkeys. The background features trees, and several animals appear to be in engaged interaction with the standing figures. The texture and composition suggest it is a satirical or comical piece, with exaggerated facial expressions and poses of both animals and figures. The drawing's style is characteristic of political or social commentary artworks typical of the 19th century.

artworks.title: a) The Last Supper; b) Putti
artworks.artist: Vincenzo Tamagni, after Leonardo da Vinci
artworks.medium:
a) pen and brown ink on two joined sheets of laid paper;
b) pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David E. Rust
artworks.description: Sketched with brown ink on now-darkened paper, thirteen men sit on the far side of a long table. They gather in clusters of three as they look and gesture toward a man at the center, Jesus, who has long hair and a beard. They all wear robes. Square openings in the space behind the table recede into the distance but are lightly sketched. Subtle vertical lines of the laid paper are visible, and the bottom center is stamped with a letter R.

artworks.title: The Harpies Attacking Aeneas and His Companions
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk, heightened with white, on gray-brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The drawing features intricate pen lines, with highlights and shading suggesting depth and movement. It depicts multiple figures engaged in a dynamic scene, possibly a battle or encounter with mythical creatures. The figures include armored human-like beings and otherworldly creatures with wings and tails. The composition is tightly packed, with figures in various postures, reaching and clashing. Swirling clouds fill the background, adding drama to the scene.

artworks.title: A Swiss Guard before an Ornamental Arch (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on red prepared laid paper, heightened with white gouache
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dian Woodner in Memory of Her Father Ian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a person in elaborate clothing holding a spear. They have one hand on their hip, wearing a hat with a feather, and have a serious expression. The background includes architectural elements, decorations, hunting dogs, and a deer in a forest landscape.

artworks.title: Glass Design with Saint John the Baptist and Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description:
The image is an intricate drawing with a scrollwork design. Two half-figures of men are shown on either side of the central section. The man on the left stands on a pedestal, facing slightly right, and appears to be holding an object. He has curly hair and a beard, and wears a draped garment. The man on the right is also standing on a pedestal, has long curly hair, a clean-shaven face, and is draped in flowing robes while holding a spherical object. Each man is backed by a decorative pillar and has a circular halo around his head.

The upper part of the drawing features an elaborate architectural border with cherubic figures and intricate detailing. In the upper corners, scenes with smaller human figures are depicted in classical architectural settings. A helmeted face is centered at the top of this border, flanked by two cherubic figures holding cornucopias. The central part of the drawing is blank except for scrollwork and heraldic embellishments. Below this, two cherubic figures play with cartouches and a lion figure as part of the ornate framing. The background is filled with mythological and lavish motifs, and the image is monochromatic, likely sketched in pen and ink.

artworks.title: Cavalry, Corporal
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a military uniform standing in a formal pose. He has a stern expression with facial hair, wearing a hat. The man wears a dark blue coat with gold trim, light blue trousers with a gold stripe, and a wide-brimmed military hat with decorations. He holds a sword and has a chest strap. The background is plain, and the floor has a subtle pattern. The text "Cavalry Corporal" is at the bottom of the photograph.

artworks.title: Cavalry, Musician
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile while holding a bugle to his lips. He has a well-groomed beard and short hair under a dark cavalry hat adorned with decorative elements. The man is wearing a dark blue military uniform jacket with gold trim and shoulder straps, light blue trousers, gloves, and a belt with a holstered sword. The background is a plain, neutral-colored backdrop, and the ground has a simple patterned floor.

artworks.title: Artillery, Private
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is positioned facing the camera with a serious expression. The man has a full beard and dark, neatly kept hair. He is wearing a dark blue military uniform with gold buttons and red details on the sleeves, a leather belt, and light blue trousers. He wears white gloves and a sash diagonally across his chest. He holds a rifle with a bayonet attached in front of him. Beside him are several rifles forming a pyramid, with a rolled blanket and a leather pouch at the base. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Light Artillery, Sergeant
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright with his left hand on his hip and his right hand holding a sword by his side. He has a bushy beard and mustache, dark hair under a hat. He wears a uniform with a dark blue jacket, light blue trousers with a red stripe, white gloves, and a shako hat with a red plume and gold emblem. A leather strap crosses his chest and his belt has a prominent buckle. The background is plain with a simple floor.
